name: company-role-investigator
description: Research companies and roles with sourced context, challenge hypotheses, and interview validation questions.

interface.shortDescription: Understand a company, a role, and what to validate in an interview.
interface.longDescription: Research company and product context, role responsibilities, and evidence-based challenge hypotheses using available public sources and user-provided material. Distinguish sourced claims, inferences, alternatives, and unknowns, then prepare interview questions that can change the assessment.
defaultPrompt: Investigate this company and Backend Team Lead role: what problems might the role actually need to solve?
What might this Engineering Manager be responsible for at this company, and which decision rights should I verify?
I received the following new information after an interview. Update the affected hypotheses in this research.
